'''Masatoshi Hamada''' (Japanese: '''浜田雅功''' ''Hamada Masatoshi''), also known as '''Hama-chan''' (Japanese: '''浜ちゃん''') is a voice actor for {{aniseries|PTS}}. He voiced {{OBP|Slowking|M02}} in the [[M02|second movie]], and also illustrated the "[[Hama-chan's Slowking (CoroCoro promo)|Hama-chan's Slowking]]" TCG promo card produced for the Japanese release of the movie. He was born on May 11, 1963 in {{wp|Osaka}}, {{wp|Japan}}.
